quantile_method: nearest-rank; n=5 implies P95 equals max

definitions.cold_initialization: Fresh manager/sandbox EnsureWorkbenchSession including workspace/runtime probes; image/template present; client construction excluded
definitions.warm_command_first_byte: Initialized sandbox after one unmeasured terminal warmup; OpenSessionCommandTerminal through first byte Read; Wait excluded
definitions.upload_1mib: WorkbenchFiles(write) with bounded helper staging/chunks/digest/fsync/atomic publish
definitions.download_1mib: WorkbenchFiles(read) through complete response; equality checked outside timed interval; immediate read after upload
definitions.payload: Deterministic repeated 00 ff 02 03 binary pattern; 1048576 bytes verified byte-for-byte

limitations: Small serial latency sample, not capacity/concurrency/SLA evidence
Go manager/provider layer only; HTTP auth, Redis, DB audit, WebSocket and browser excluded
Host, daemon, image layers, node and OS page caches are warm
Local E2B-compatible containers, not E2B Cloud or MicroVM isolation
No 50-way concurrency; documented single-user limit is four
Shared development host, not reserved benchmark hardware; other agents and services may run concurrently
